ja: “袖付き”の特徴を、新規パーツと成形色で忠実に再現！！
機動戦士ガンダムUCの設定を完全再現した‘episode3’に登場のドラッツェがいよいよリリース！
劇中に登場のＭ.Ｓ.を揃えて、ユニコーンの世界観を堪能しよう！
●特徴的な右手のガトリングと腕の一体化装着部の他、マークが刻まれた胸部と袖部に新規パーツを採用
●本体のパープルの塗り分けは成形色により再現
●胸と手首部分のエングレーピングは専用ホイルシールが付属。
１／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル

en: The features of “sleeves” are faithfully reproduced with new parts and molding colors! !
The Doratze that appeared in 'episode 3', which completely reproduces the setting of Mobile Suit Gundam UC, is finally released!
Get the MS that appears in the movie and enjoy the world of unicorns!
- In addition to the characteristic right hand Gatling and integrated arm attachment, new parts are used on the chest and sleeve parts with marks engraved on them.
-The purple coloring of the main body is reproduced by molding color.
-Special foil seals are included for the engraving on the chest and wrists.
Target age: 8 years old and above
*No adhesive is used in the assembly
・This product is a limited edition item.
*We may sell items at events sponsored by our company or other projects.
*Cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・Product images are prototypes. Specifications may change slightly.
- Product specifications are scheduled as of 201111. Please note that there may be changes.
